verdict.rationale: The repo ships an AGENTS.md with a command reference table an agent can read (add, list, update, init, sync, lockfile restore). A markdown version of the Agent Skills specification is also served at agentskills.io/specification.md. However, there is no llms.txt evidence, and the probe for a markdown docs endpoint (skills.md) returned 404. missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, a working markdown docs endpoint for skills.sh itself, and hands-on evidence of an agent actually consuming these docs.
